rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Now the rook's helper is the knight. It works up close and jumps over pieces.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: From f6, the knight attacks g8 and h7. Your king guards g7 and h7.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: The black king has no free square. Only the rook's check is missing.
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: Checkmate! The rook attacks the edge, the knight guards g8 and the king guards g7 and h7.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes to a8 and checks along the edge. Every escape square is taken.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.a1h1.1: Also mate! Along the h-file the rook checks, and the knight guards g8.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.f6e4.1: The knight left f6, and there was no check.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.f6e4.2: The black king runs to g8.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.f6e4.3: Let's go back: the knight stays, and the rook gives the check.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not give mate. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Remember: the knight takes the escape square up close, and the rook closes the edge.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Here, if the rook checks on the edge now, the black king escapes through h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: First take the knight to a square from which it attacks h7. Then comes the mate.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Prepare the mate with the knight, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! From g5, the knight attacks h7. The black king only has g8.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The knight jumps to g5 and attacks h7. The black king is left with only g8.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.1: It is check, but h7 is still free.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.2: The black king escapes to h7.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.3: Let's go back: first the knight, then the rook.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not prepare the mate. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Prepare the mate with the knight, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: The black king goes to g8, its only square.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Checkmate! The knight guards h7, the king guards f7 and g7.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Now I will show a famous rook and knight mate, and a danger: stalemate.
rot.demos.arabe.e1: This is the Arabian mate: the rook next to the king, and the knight protecting the rook.
rot.demos.arabe.l1: The knight jumps to f6 and gives check.
rot.demos.arabe.l2: The black king goes to the corner. On f8 it would escape, but here it errs.
rot.demos.arabe.l3: Checkmate! The knight protects the rook and also guards g8.
rot.demos.afogamento.e1: Now a danger. Count the black king's squares: your king guards g7 and h7. Only g8 is left.
rot.demos.afogamento.l1: If the knight went to f6, it would take g8 without check. The black king would have no move: stalemate.
rot.demos.afogamento.l2: The rook solves it: it gives check and takes g8 at the same time. Checkmate!
rot.demos.afogamento.l3: Now it's your turn: cut the king off with the rook, take squares with the knight and count squares before the mate.
rot.pratica.preparar.enunciado: Give checkmate. The black king has a7 and b8. First attack a7 with the knight, then the rook.
rot.pratica.preparar.fim: Perfect. The knight took a7, and the rook gave mate.
rot.pratica.preparar.err.h1h8: It is check, but the king escapes through a7. Try again.
rot.pratica.centro.enunciado: The black king is in the center. Cut it off with the rook, bring your king close and use the knight.
rot.pratica.centro.fim: Well done. You knew how to use the knight.
